text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 17: Wind, radiation, and precipitation-type columns, for the 51 ensemble members (precipitation type: control member only)'
text.tspan: Figure 17: Wind, radiation, and precipitation-type columns, for the 51
ensemble members (precipitation type: control member only)

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One ECMWF ensemble run from the validation year: the run whose PV farm mean actual power over its first 10 days is the median of the 53 runs. The six remaining weather columns: wind speed at 10 m and 100 m in metres per second, wind direction at 10 m and 100 m in degrees, downward short-wave radiation in watts per square metre, and precipitation type (a category code). Each panel has its own y axis. The solar and wind generators share a weather grid cell, so one column serves both. Precipitation type draws the control member only.'
